pages.title: Current Features
pages.text: Here are ways to learn, transform, travel, fight, feed, and work by the forge. All three dragon types and both sexes have human forms at stages three to five.$(br2)Read $(l:dragonmaid:getting_started/milestones)your keepsakes$(/l) for milestones.

pages.title: Further Along
pages.text: The first three knowledge levels expand your dragon’s pack. At level two, it can carry a weapon and shield. Find the requirements in $(l:dragonmaid:learning/books)Lessons and Lore$(/l).$(br2)Higher knowledge levels, humanoid riding, and new ways to spend time together await a future update.

pages.title: Guide Illustrations
pages.text: Landscapes and moments from your travels have found a place in this book. More stories are waiting for you to write them together.

pages.title: Global Settings
pages.text: Use the mod configuration from the main menu to adjust tamed dragons' health, damage, growth limit, scale drops and miniature size. Wild dragons retain Ice and Fire's values.$(br2)Choose animated or direct human-form attacks, or turn off the first-entry guide.

pages.title: Settings Files
pages.text: Both global files are in the config folder:$(br2)Main settings:$(br)dragonmaid-common.toml$(br2)Recall altar settings:$(br)dragonmaid-recall-common.toml

pages.title: Applying Settings
pages.text: Global settings also apply to existing worlds. Re-enter the world or restart the server after changes.$(br2)In multiplayer, the server's settings take precedence for that session without overwriting your local files.

pages.title: Companion Details
pages.text: Use /dragonmaid help for command help. /dragonmaid get all lists your companions; click a reported value to copy it.$(br2)Filter by species, name and count. Companions sharing a name are selected nearest first.

pages.title: Age and Hunger
pages.text: The age and hunger commands use set, add or remove. They require cheats or operator permission and affect only your loaded companions in your dimension.$(br2)/dragonmaid age add 1 fire * 1$(br)adds one day to your nearest fire dragon.

pages.title: Return Teleporting
pages.text: With cheats or operator permission, use:$(br2)/dragonmaid teleport off$(br)Replace off with on to enable it, or status to check the setting.$(br2)This controls automatic return teleporting, not ordinary following, crystals or recall altars.

pages.title: Incubation Time
pages.text: To adjust incubation progress, use:$(br2)/dragonmaid egg remaining 60$(br2)With cheats or operator permission, this sets the nearest egg within 32 blocks to 60 seconds remaining. Ice eggs must freeze first. The usual incubation conditions still apply.
